kutipan: An early start, a cold trail, and a morning on Andong together.

items.caption: Sawit Basecamp, Magelang. A cold start before sunrise.
items.alt: Suasana awal pendakian di Basecamp Sawit Gunung Andong

kutipan: Still catching our breath. A good place to stop.

items.caption: A quiet stop in the grass, with time to catch our breath.
items.alt: Pasangan tersenyum hangat berdua di hamparan sabana Gunung Andong

items.caption: Merbabu in the distance, warm tea in hand.
items.alt: Pemandangan cakrawala pegunungan dari punggungan sabana

items.caption: Holding hands in the wind.
items.alt: Genggaman tangan bersarung wol di jalur sabana

items.caption: Green hills along the trail.
items.alt: Pemandangan punggung bukit sabana Gunung Andong nan asri

kutipan: No photos here. We were too busy getting up the hill.
narasi: It was steeper than it looked.
Just footsteps on gravel and a few stops to catch our breath.

kutipan: We made it. Time to sit down and take in the view.

items.caption: At the summit sign: 1,726 metres above sea level.
items.alt: Puncak Makam dan Alap-alap Gunung Andong berlatar awan pagi

items.caption: Tents on the ridge before first light.
items.alt: Tenda hangat di puncak di bawah gemerlap malam

kutipan: We hoped for a sea of clouds. We got a clear blue sky, and it was enough.

items.caption: An open view from the summit.
items.alt: Pemandangan luas puncak dengan langit biru cerah tanpa awan

items.caption: Sitting in the breeze with nowhere to rush.
items.alt: Pasangan duduk tersenyum menatap langit biru lapang di puncak Andong

items.caption: Telomoyo and Merbabu on a clear morning.
items.alt: Panorama pegunungan sekitar Gunung Andong di pagi hari yang cerah

narasi: A clear view in every direction.
I thought there would be clouds below us.
At least we get a good view of Merbabu.

kutipan: The day began in colors no camera could get right.

items.caption: The first sunlight over the eastern horizon.
items.alt: Momen matahari terbit menyinari puncak Gunung Andong

items.caption: Hot tea in the cold morning air.
items.alt: Dua cangkir teh hangat diangkat berlatar sunrise keemasan

items.caption: Watching the sunrise together.
items.alt: Siluet dua orang berpegangan tangan menatap fajar terbit

items.caption: The sun above the low mist.
items.alt: Pemandangan matahari terbit utuh di atas lautan kabut

kutipan: A good hike, and good company. Until the next one.

items.caption: A photo to remember the hike by.
items.alt: Foto kenangan penutup pendakian Gunung Andong
